desc: Derive the algebraic DP/transfer-matrix formulation for the weighted monotone-path sum and identify how a single cell update changes it.
Rule out ordinary offline time divide-and-conquer based on a flat contraction/transfer graph of touched cells, due to potentially quadratic dense terminal interactions.
Fix and sample-verify the direct O(HW)-per-update DP baseline by resetting its state for every query.
Implement and sample-verify the O(log max(H,W)) transfer-matrix solution when H=2 or W=2.
Derive and sample-verify a zero-safe cursor-walk block/rectangle recomputation algorithm.
Derive the recursive temporal rectangle hierarchy with claimed \(O(QN^{16/31}+N)\) work and division-free handling of zero values.
Verify the recursive hierarchy boundary-state invariant and output values with randomized brute-force testing on small instances.
Establish practical worst-case runtime bounds, including all grid aspect ratios and Python constant factors, and adjust hierarchy depth/block sizes if needed.
Optimize the verified implementation, including avoiding repeated temporary allocation in local crossing DP where beneficial, then re-run samples and stress tests.
